Depends on the Demonic Essences (from hours to weeks)

Members of the {wiki:Nightmare Knights|Nightmare Knights} can use the Nightmare outfit. Earn it by advancing through the missions of the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest|Dreamer's Challenge Quest} and using the documents of each rank: {item:Document of the Follower} (outfit), {item:Document of the Officer} (shield/spear) and {item:Document of the Leader} (helmet).
Joining the Nightmare Knights in the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest|Dreamer's Challenge Quest} (recommended level 40–70+).
Missions 1 to 4 of the Dreamer's Challenge for the outfit; mission 5 for the shield/spear addon; mission 6 for the helmet addon.
500 for the shield addon + 1000 for the helmet one

If you join the {wiki:Brotherhood of Bones|Brotherhood of Bones} instead of the Nightmare Knights, you get the Brotherhood outfit and not this one: you can only choose one faction.

The documents can be given by another player who has already handed in 3000 essences (mission 7 of the Dreamer's Challenge Quest). You can also receive them yourself if you hand in 3000 {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences} in total.

Complete missions 1 to 4 of the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest|Dreamer's Challenge Quest}, joining the Nightmare Knights. The entrance is in the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, **southwest** of Venore: from the Plains of Havoc temple walk **east** to the ruined building, use the {item:Shovel} on the hole to the **northeast** and go down; further on you clear the way with a {item:Pick}.

To leave the {wiki:Dream Realm}, enter the teleport near {npc:A Ghostly Guardian}. After you join the Nightmare Knights you can use the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower} teleports (Carlin, Thais and Dream Realm; more cities with the following ranks) so you do not have to cross the Plains of Havoc again: you always need an {item:Orichalcum Pearl}.
Use a {item:Document of the Follower}. You get the Nightmare outfit.

Go to the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower}, in the south of the Plains of Havoc, and enter through the hole hidden behind a tree, by the water, a little **north** of the tower. Go up to the **2nd floor** and use the teleport to the **Dream Realm** (you need to have an {item:Orichalcum Pearl} with you).
Hidden hole behind the tree (Knightwatch Tower)
Complete mission 5 of the Dreamer's Challenge Quest by handing in 500 {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences}.
To go back to the NPC after mission 4, you need an {item:Orichalcum Pearl}: go to the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower|Knightwatch Tower} and enter one of the portals.

Enter the teleport near {npc:A Ghostly Guardian}. With an {item:Orichalcum Pearl} and the Nightmare Knights rank, the teleports on the 2nd floor of the Knightwatch Tower take you to **Thais** or **Carlin**; without a pearl, walk back through the Plains of Havoc to Venore, to the **northeast**.
Use a {item:Document of the Officer}. You get the shield/spear addon.

Complete mission 6 of the Dreamer's Challenge Quest by handing in **another 1000** {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences}. Enter and leave the Dream Realm as in mission 5 (Knightwatch Tower + {item:Orichalcum Pearl}).
Use a {item:Document of the Leader}. You get the helmet addon.

**How do you get the documents?** A player who has already handed in 3000 essences (mission 7 of the Dreamer's Challenge Quest) can give them to you. Alternatively, hand in 3000 essences in total yourself to receive them.
**How do you go back to the NPC after mission 4?** You need an {item:Orichalcum Pearl}. Look for the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower|Knightwatch Tower} and enter one of the portals.
